title: Unpackable Honeycomb
description: Unpacking recipe for Honeycomb Block. Revert it back into 4x Honeycombs in the crafting table.
body:
# Unpackable Honeycomb

A simple and lightweight quality-of-life addition that allows you to unpack and revert Honeycomb Blocks back into Honeycombs, making it easier to store vast amounts of Honeycomb Blocks without losing the ability to turn them back when needed.

## Crafting Recipes

This adds standard shapeless vanilla unpacking mechanics to the crafting table:

- **1x Honeycomb Block** -> **4x Honeycomb**
